_README: Copy this file to 'Appsettings.json' in the same folder and replace the placeholder values.
Appsettings.json is gitignored on purpose - never commit a filled-in copy.
No SMTP password is needed: mail is submitted unauthenticated to the internal relay.
Log location is not configured here - see NLog.config, which writes to a 'logs' folder next to the exe.

myDomainControllers is OPTIONAL: leave it empty to discover domain controllers from AD, which is normally what you want. Set it only to restrict the lockout search to specific DCs - a hardcoded list goes stale when a DC is added or retired.
